product.name: Monoprice Premium Ultra Durable Nylon Braided Apple MFi Certified Lightning to 3.5mm Jack Audio Adapter - Black
product.description: Listen to headphones, connect to speakers, or stream music through any audio system from your iPhone® with this Monoprice MFi Certified Lightning® to 3.5mm Audio Adapter.This adapter is certified to work with any Apple® Lightning device and supports microphone connectivity, allowing for phone calls and audio recording through compatible 3.5mm audio accessories.Built with premium materials, including a durable nylon-braided cable, it ensures long-lasting, reliable performance.
